title: Inference error mapping and trace enrichment dashboard
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Create a unified failure taxonomy and accompanying Grafana dashboard suite that helps SREs and PMs quickly triage inference failures across hosted/dedicated/private deployments. This ticket covers (1) defining failure classes (timeouts, overload/backpressure, model runtime errors, bad model outputs, HTTP/gRPC status codes mapping), (2) instrumenting tracing hooks and log enrichment to produce a structured 'failure_reason' field, (3) adding metrics and log pipeline parsers so dashboards can show per-route/per-model breakdowns, and (4) alert/runbook updates.
scope:
- Failure classes: TIMEOUT, OVERLOAD, MODEL_ERROR, MODEL_OUTPUT_INVALID, PROTOCOL_ERROR (HTTP 4xx/5xx, gRPC codes).
- Trace enrichment: attach request_id, model_version, route, backend_node_id, batch_size, kv_cache_hit, and failure_reason to root span.
- Metrics: add counter/frequency for failure_reason, histogram for server latency by outcome, saturation metrics for GPU queueing and batching delays.
- Logs: structured log field failure_reason and upstream/http_status/grpc_code.
- Dashboard: Grafana panels for top failure types, heatmap by service/region/model, long-tail traces list with links to Tempo, and queryable examples for PagerDuty runbooks.
implementation_notes:
Decisions and constraints:
- Use OpenTelemetry semantic conventions for spans and attributes to maximize cross-system compatibility.
- Traces -> Tempo, Metrics -> Prometheus, Logs -> Loki + ClickHouse for long-term analytics.
- Use a Kafka topic 'observability.enriched.events' for enriched event stream to downstream analytics.
- Keep per-request enrichment cheap: only add fields already available in request headers or runtime context; avoid synchronous calls.
- For model runtime errors, canonicalize runtime exceptions into MODEL_ERROR with subcodes (e.g., INVALID_WEIGHTS, CUDA_OOM, TOKENIZATION_ERROR).
- Map HTTP/gRPC status codes to taxonomy: 408->TIMEOUT, 429->OVERLOAD, 5xx->PROTOCOL_ERROR unless model reported failure_reason.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Dashboard shows counts and latency percentiles grouped by failure_reason for last 24h and 7d.
2) Traces opened from dashboard link to Tempo with the expected enriched attributes present.
3) Alerts fire on sustained spike in OVERLOAD or TIMEOUT per region above thresholds defined in runbook.
4) On a seeded fault (simulated model runtime error), failure is classified as MODEL_ERROR and appears in dashboard within 60s.
5) Unit/integration tests for parser logic and span enrichment exist and pass in CI.
